data.title: Calculating Remaining Percentages in Discounts
data.description: Practice determining the remaining percentage of an original price after a markdown by subtracting discount rates from one hundred percent.

challenges.scenario: A $20 backpack is on clearance — 25% off.
challenges.question: What percent of the original price remains after the discount?

challenges.scenario: A bookstore has a 15% off coupon on a $120 book.
challenges.question: What percent of the price will you pay with the coupon? Place that percent on the bar.

challenges.scenario: A $100 backpack is on clearance — 40% off.
challenges.question: What percent of the original price remains after the discount?

challenges.scenario: A bookstore has a 50% off coupon on a $40 book.
challenges.question: What percent of the price will you pay with the coupon? Place that percent on the bar.
